Subject: VP/CTO onramp — proposed slots and technical scope

Hi Alicia / Carlos — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the VP/CTO handshake and technical deep dive scheduled so we can unblock a pilot: 

Summary of what you shared (high level)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for real-time fraud scoring (99th pct latency target ~ < 120ms).
- Current pain: unpredictable tail latency under spiky traffic, and high per-token spend for batch scoring.
- Success criteria: sub-120ms 99th, 3x reduction in cost per scored event, and clear plan for integration with existing infra and logging.

Proposed next meeting: VP/CTO handshake + 45m technical onramp (intro + infra deep dive). Can you confirm who from your side will attend (VP, CTO, infra lead)? I recommend we include a short mutual action plan and a focused runbook for the deep dive.

Three proposed windows (Pacific time):
1) Mon 24 May — 09:00–09:45 PT
2) Mon 24 May — 11:30–12:15 PT
3) Tue 25 May — 13:00–13:45 PT

Attachments: attaching a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf) that outlines owners and deliverables for the next 60 days.

If one of the windows works, reply with your preferred slot and who will join. If none work, propose two alternatives and we’ll loop in Karthik and Marissa to lock a time.

Prep we’ll do on our side:
- 20m cost/latency snapshot for a comparable fraud-scoring workload (Karthik)
- 25m infra/deployment runbook + integration checklist (Vivek)
- AE-side success criteria and pilot runway (Marissa)

Thanks — looking forward to locking something.

Best,
Kimberly Park
